checks: ∀ (n : ℕ) (f : (Fin n → ℝ) → ℝ), Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → Integrable f

∀ (n : ℕ) (F F' : ℝ → (Fin n → ℝ) → ℝ)
  (b : (Fin n → ℝ) → ℝ) (t₀ : ℝ) (s : Set ℝ),
  s ∈ 𝓝 t₀ →
  (∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 t₀, AEStronglyMeasurable (F t) volume) →
  Integrable (F t₀) →
  AEStronglyMeasurable (F' t₀) volume →
  (∀ᵐ x ∂volume, ∀ t ∈ s, ‖F' t x‖ ≤ b x) →
  Integrable b →
  (∀ᵐ x ∂volume, ∀ t ∈ s, HasDerivAt (fun r => F r x) (F' t x) t) →
  Integrable (F' t₀) ∧
    HasDerivAt (fun t => ∫ x, F t x) (∫ x, F' t₀ x) t₀

∀ (n : ℕ) (f g : (Fin n → ℝ) → ℝ) (v : Fin n → ℝ),
  Integrable (fun x => fderiv ℝ f x v * g x) →
  Integrable (fun x => f x * fderiv ℝ g x v) →
  Integrable (fun x => f x * g x) →
  (∀ x ∈ tsupport g, DifferentiableAt ℝ f x) →
  (∀ x ∈ tsupport f, DifferentiableAt ℝ g x) →
  (∫ x, f x * fderiv ℝ g x v) = -(∫ x, fderiv ℝ f x v * g x)

∀ (f g : ℝ → ℝ) (f' g' t : ℝ), HasDerivAt f f' t → HasDerivAt g g' t →
  HasDerivAt (fun r => f r * g r) (f' * g t + f t * g') t

∀ (E F : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
  [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] (f : E → F) (x : E),
  ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f x →
  ∀ v w : E, fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) x v w = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) x w v

∀ (E F : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
  [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] (f : E → F) (U : Set E),
  IsOpen U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ f) U

∀ (E F : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
  [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] (f : E → F) (c : F) (x : E),
  (f =ᶠ[𝓝 x] fun _ => c) → fderiv ℝ f x = 0

∀ (n : ℕ) (K : Set ((Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ)) (f : ((Fin n → ℝ) × ℝ) → ℝ),
  IsCompact K → ContinuousOn f K → ∃ B : ℝ, ∀ p ∈ K, ‖f p‖ ≤ B

∀ (n : ℕ) (K : Set (Fin n → ℝ)) (B : ℝ),
  IsCompact K → Integrable (K.indicator (fun _ => B))
